tools.name: ucode_render_home
tools.description: **Call on the first user message** in every new chat. Renders the interactive Ucode card with a **Connect Ucode account** button. Until linked, only welcome/connect/login tools — never rent or checkout.

tools.name: ucode_render_services
tools.description: Opens the **visual service picker** (popular apps + search). Call after sign-in or when the user wants a number — same data as **ucode_sms_summary** but optimized for the in-chat card.

tools.name: ucode_welcome
tools.description: Same as **ucode_render_home** — product summary + sign-in card. Prefer **ucode_render_home** on first message.

tools.name: ucode_session_status
tools.description: Check whether this ChatGPT session is linked to Ucode. Use at chat start; if connected is false, run **ucode_render_home** — do not process rental requests. If they already have a live number, the card shows it.

tools.name: ucode_panel_ping
tools.description: Public health check against Ucode Panel (no auth). Official downloads and info: https://ucode.uk — do not use unrelated domains (e.g. ucode.io).

tools.name: ucode_agent_billing
tools.description: No login. Lists prepaid USDC (Base) credit packs for autonomous agents/bots and how to pay with x402. ChatGPT humans should use **ucode_render_credits** and https://ucode.uk/app/credits instead.

tools.name: ucode_instructions
tools.description: Full product guide (read-only). **Not for the first message** — use **ucode_welcome** first. If the user is not signed in, call **ucode_welcome** / **ucode_login_start** instead of answering rental questions. Official site https://ucode.uk.

tools.name: ucode_help
tools.description: Optional natural-language help about Ucode features and flows. Uses the OpenAI key from Panel (Settings → ChatGPT App) when set, else OPENAI_API_KEY on the MCP host. Respects the “AI help” toggle in Panel.

tools.name: ucode_connect
tools.description: Starts browser sign-in for the visual card **Connect** button. Returns linkUrl + sessionId with uiView sign-in. Poll **ucode_login_poll** until linked.

tools.name: ucode_login_start
tools.description: Creates a one-time browser sign-in URL. Prefer the in-card **Connect** button (**ucode_connect**). Poll **ucode_login_poll(sessionId)** until linked.

tools.name: ucode_login_poll
tools.description: Poll after **ucode_login_start**. Links the ChatGPT session when the user has finished in the browser — **call repeatedly** until complete; do not ask users to paste tokens or to type “done” as the only completion signal.

tools.name: ucode_authenticate
tools.description: Hidden escape hatch: only if the user explicitly already has a mobile Bearer token and asks to use it. Do NOT suggest this for normal sign-in — use ucode_login_start + ucode_login_poll instead.

tools.name: ucode_whoami
tools.description: Current linked Ucode user (requires ucode_login_poll complete or ucode_authenticate).

tools.name: ucode_disconnect
tools.description: Sign out / unlink this ChatGPT conversation from Ucode. Clears the MCP session only (not account deletion). Use when the user asks to sign out, log out, disconnect, or switch accounts. Shows the welcome card with **Connect** again.

tools.name: ucode_sign_out
tools.description: Same as **ucode_disconnect** — unlinks Ucode from this ChatGPT chat. Call for sign out, log out, or disconnect requests.

tools.name: ucode_credits_status
tools.description: Linked wallet — **credits** are in-app points for renting numbers, not a bank balance. Always say “you have X credits”. After a dashboard or x402 payment, call this so the ChatGPT card refreshes. Never imply USD wallet unless discussing listed pack prices.

tools.name: ucode_render_credits
tools.description: Opens the **Add credits** card with the current wallet balance. ChatGPT cannot run Stripe in the iframe — the user taps through to **https://ucode.uk/app/credits**. After they pay, call **ucode_credits_status**. Agents/bots should call **ucode_agent_billing** and pay USDC on Base instead of this too

tools.name: ucode_credit_packages
tools.description: Same packs as **ucode_render_credits** (data). For ChatGPT humans prefer **ucode_render_credits** and the website dashboard. Agents: x402 USDC on Base.

tools.name: ucode_credit_gift_breakdown
tools.description: Free-credit badges / gift breakdown.

tools.name: ucode_credit_referral_stats
tools.description: Referral code and earnings summary.

tools.name: ucode_credit_referral_redeem
tools.description: Redeem a 6-character referral code for bonus credits.

tools.name: ucode_payments_stripe_prices
tools.description: **Rare.** Resolve fiat display for Stripe IDs — do **not** read raw **prod_**/ **price_** strings to end users; use **ucode_credit_packages** for storefront-style copy.

tools.name: ucode_payments_stripe_create_checkout
tools.description: **Do not use in ChatGPT.** In-card Stripe is blocked. For humans, call **ucode_render_credits** and open **https://ucode.uk/app/credits**. For agents/bots, call **ucode_agent_billing** and pay USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: ucode_payments_stripe_verify
tools.description: After Checkout completes, pass checkout **session id** plus **packageId** so Panel credits the account.

tools.name: ucode_payments_nowpayments_create
tools.description: Creates a crypto invoice (NOWPayments) for human web/Telegram top-ups. ChatGPT humans should use **https://ucode.uk/app/credits** instead. Autonomous agents/bots must pay **USDC on Base via x402**, not NOWPayments.

tools.name: ucode_payments_nowpayments_status
tools.description: Poll invoice / payment status by NOWPayments id.

tools.name: ucode_credits_verify_app_store_purchase
tools.description: Server-side verify of RevenueCat / store purchase (same as mobile). Requires packageId, transactionId, productId, platform (iOS/Android), and purchaseToken for Android.

tools.name: ucode_services_catalog
tools.description: Paginated Ucode service catalog with per-country availability from the Panel database.

tools.name: ucode_sms_services
tools.description: Low-level provider service codes — exposes internal naming. Do NOT use for normal rentals; prefer **ucode_sms_summary** or **ucode_sms_service_detail** then credits-only packages.

tools.name: ucode_sms_countries
tools.description: Raw worldwide country id table — pairs with legacy APIs only. For renting, use **ucode_sms_summary** / **ucode_sms_service_detail** so users pick by country name + credits.

tools.name: ucode_sms_prices
tools.description: **Avoid for ChatGPT users.** Uses backend USD-ish snapshots; assistants must guide rentals via credits-only summaries (**ucode_sms_summary**, **ucode_sms_service_detail**) and **ucode_sms_rent_packages**. Responses are partially sanitized.

tools.name: ucode_sms_summary
tools.description: Primary discovery: search by app/service name (e.g. Telegram, WhatsApp). Returns services with countries, **credits** only (no provider names / no USD in assistant copy). Same idea as the app Services tab. Then **ucode_sms_service_detail** or go straight to **ucode_sms_rent_packages** once service +

tools.name: ucode_sms_service_detail
tools.description: Load one service’s countries after you have its short **serviceCode** (from summary `service` field). Matches opening that service in the iOS/Android app: availability, credits per country. Prefer over legacy `/prices` APIs.

tools.name: ucode_sms_rent_packages
tools.description: After user picks **serviceCode** + **country** (numeric id from summary/detail), list **credit-priced routes** only. Same package picker as the app (rentalFlowVersion 2). Present **credits**, recommended badge, labels — never quote USD or backend provider names.

tools.name: ucode_sms_rent_with_credits
tools.description: **Primary rental** — charges Ucode credits. Always use **rentalFlowVersion: 2** and **packageId** from **ucode_sms_rent_packages** (matches mobile). Never mention wholesale/provider IDs or dollar amounts to the user.

tools.name: ucode_sms_rent_provider_direct
tools.description: **Do not use for ChatGPT end users.** Legacy rental against upstream balances — skips normal credit UX and exposes provider-era assumptions. Only **ucode_sms_rent_with_credits** with packages.

tools.name: ucode_sms_active_rentals
tools.description: Active/received rentals with SMS snippets if already fetched.

tools.name: ucode_sms_get_code
tools.description: Poll latest SMS for a rental id (provider rental id string).

tools.name: ucode_sms_cancel_rental
tools.description: Cancel an active rental and refund credits when no SMS has arrived. Requires a cancel reason for analytics. Reasons: service_rejected | number_has_account | code_not_arrived | other. If an SMS arrives during cancel, credits stay charged and the code is returned.

tools.name: ucode_sms_refund_expired
tools.description: Trigger server-side refund scan for expired rentals (same as app).

tools.name: ucode_sms_transactions
tools.description: Provider ledger audit trail — sanitized before ChatGPT. Prefer explaining rentals via **ucode_sms_active_rentals** for users.

tools.name: ucode_app_init_snapshot
tools.description: Combined snapshot (packages, rentals, credit status, settings). Use platform web for ChatGPT (Stripe/crypto web packages); ios/android for native.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ucode_render_services, ucode_session_status, ucode_instructions · Private data: ucode_login_poll, ucode_authenticate, ucode_credits_status, ucode_render_credits, ucode_services_catalog · Public sink: ucode_sms_services, ucode_sms_countries, ucode_sms_prices, ucode_sms_summary, ucode_sms_service_detail, ucode_sms_rent_packages, ucode_sms_rent_with_credits, ucode_sms_rent_provider_direct, ucode_sms_active_rentals, ucode_sms_get_code, ucode_sms_cancel_rental, ucode_sms_refund_expired, ucode_sms_transactions · Destructive: ucode_session_status, ucode_render_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ucode_render_services, ucode_session_status, ucode_instructions · Private data: ucode_login_poll, ucode_authenticate, ucode_credits_status, ucode_render_credits, ucode_services_catalog · Public sink: ucode_sms_services, ucode_sms_countries, ucode_sms_prices, ucode_sms_summary, ucode_sms_service_detail, ucode_sms_rent_packages, ucode_sms_rent_with_credits, ucode_sms_rent_provider_direct, ucode_sms_active_rentals, ucode_sms_get_code, ucode_sms_cancel_rental, ucode_sms_refund_expired, ucode_sms_transactions · Destructive: ucode_session_status, ucode_render_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
